correctness.rationale: Uniform cardinality-parity prefix parameterization proves the exact trace obstruction for all integers k>=1,L>=2. A single rigid endpoint trace determines every forbidden facet. Face counting follows. The full join's integral homology and explicit join cycles give a split surjection onto all omitted facets for L>=3; the pair long exact sequence yields free top homology and no other groups. The length-two complex is exactly a crosspolytope boundary or its codimension-one skeleton. Two independent finite enumerators agree in all 24 cases, and finite boundary ranks agree in 18 cases. Crucial small k=1 and L=2 boundary conventions are explicit.

value.rationale: The naturally defined global parity filter on ideals of disjoint chains changes which extremal antichains can be shattered, while leaving all proper transversals intact. The exact all-parameter face and integral homology formulas expose an exponential parity-sensitive Betti difference of 2^k at every even length >=4 and an exceptional one-degree homology shift at length two. These structural invariants go beyond generic width/VC observations and supply exact tests for parity-constrained distributive-lattice learning and trace topology.
